messages.text: Morning everyone! Great weather today
Yeah, perfect for the weekend!
Team - got some concerning news from PowerCell Systems
About the battery module? What's going on?
They had a quality issue in their manufacturing line. Failed some internal QA tests.
Oh no. How bad is the delay?
They need to re-run the batch. Original date was Nov 1, now looking at Nov 20.
That's almost 3 weeks! Have we confirmed Nov 20 is firm?
Yes, spoke with their VP of Operations. November 20, 2023 is the committed date.
This is going to impact avionics testing. The battery integration test was scheduled for Nov 5.
I know. We need to loop in the test team ASAP.
Can we expedite or find an alternative supplier?
Checked with three other vendors. Nobody can meet the specs and deliver before Nov 20. PowerCell is our only option.
Understood. I'll update the tracking system with the new battery module date: November 20, 2023.
Anyone know what's for lunch in the cafeteria today?
I think it's taco Tuesday!
Morning avionics team
Hey! Ready for the battery integration test next month?
Yeah, we have Nov 5 locked in for the battery test. Lab 2 is reserved.
Perfect. That feeds into the full system test on Nov 20.
Wait, I'm seeing something in supply-chain channel... battery module delayed to Nov 20?
WHAT? Our test is Nov 5. We can't test without the battery!
This is bad. The battery test is a hard dependency for the system flight test.
Let me think... if battery arrives Nov 20, we'd need at least 3 days for integration test setup.
So earliest we could run battery integration test is like... November 23?
That's cutting it really close. System flight test is scheduled for Nov 20.
We can't run the system test without completing battery integration first. It's a critical blocker.
So if battery test slips to Nov 23, system test would have to move to... late November at earliest?
This is a cascade failure. System test delay means we put the Q4 flight readiness milestone at serious risk.
Q4 flight readiness is Nov 30. That's a regulatory deadline - we can't miss it.
If system test slips past Nov 20, we have basically zero margin for any issues.
We need to escalate this to management immediately. This is critical path.
Who wants to play ping pong at lunch?
Count me in!
Hey, anyone tracking the Q4 flight readiness milestone?
Yeah, it's locked for November 30. That's our FAA certification deadline.
What's the critical path? System flight test on Nov 20?
Correct. System test must complete by Nov 20 to have buffer for Q4 readiness on Nov 30.
But wait - if battery test slips to Nov 23, that's AFTER the system test date!
Oh no... system test depends on battery test completion. We can't run it before Nov 23.
This means system test would have to slip to late November at earliest.
That puts Q4 flight readiness at serious risk. We'd have almost zero margin.
This is a cascading failure. Battery delay → battery test delay → system test delay → Q4 milestone at risk!
Is there a team meeting today?
Nope, all clear!
Following up on the battery delay - has anyone calculated the downstream impact?
Good question. Battery arrives Nov 20, battery test would be Nov 23 at earliest.
And system flight test depends on battery test, so that slips too.
Which means Q4 flight readiness on Nov 30 has basically zero buffer. That's a regulatory deadline.
This is worse than I thought. One part delay cascading to a critical milestone.
We need to explore expedited shipping or alternative suppliers immediately.
Agreed. Let me reach out to PowerCell again and see if they can commit to anything earlier than Nov 20.
